prd.product_overview: Create a simple product management system for managing products.
functional_requirements: The system should store product ID, name, price, and stock.
The system should prevent duplicate product IDs.
The system should allow updating product information.
The system should allow deleting and searching products.

user_stories: As an admin, I want to add a product so that I can manage inventory.
As an admin, I want to update product information so that product data stays correct.
As an admin, I want to delete a product so that outdated products can be removed.

architecture_outline.data_flow: User input is received by the manager class, processed by CRUD methods, stored in an in-memory dictionary, and returned as structured results.
